## Independent re-derivation: kic-005950408 (first-screen signal; not a planet)

All numbers below come from `/home/user/ZyushgPlanet/runs/poolA_main/adversarial/kic-005950408/rederive/rederive_results.json`, produced by `rederive_kic005950408.py` in the same directory (own loader, own 1-d running-median detrend, astropy BoxLeastSquares on an own log-uniform grid; no code from `pipeline/` was read or imported). vet.json was read only after these numbers existed.

**Verdict: the 38.6067-d / ~4100-ppm signal is a PSF-photometry artefact confined to CCD channel 25, not a transit on this star. It is not recovered blind, and it vanishes when the affected quarters are removed.**

### 1. Data
49,816 quality-0 cadences; 48,146 after an upward-only 3-MAD clip; point MAD 786 ppm; baseline 1470 d. Per-quarter inspection of the FITS headers shows the star lands on channel 25 (module 9, output 1) in every season-3 quarter (Q0, 1, 5, 9, 13, 17). In those quarters the PSF fit's median RED_CHI2 is 1.4e6-2.3e6 (vs 400-6000 elsewhere), the raw per-quarter MAD is 13,000-80,000 ppm, and the PSF flux shows +-10% multi-day swings and a 43% drop at t~1273 BKJD. I therefore analysed two datasets: **A** = all quality-0 cadences (what a blind pipeline sees) and **B** = A minus the six channel-25 quarters (a post-hoc, data-driven mask, labelled as such; 36,383 points, MAD 699 ppm).

### 2. Blind BLS 1-50 d (own grid, 287,589 periods, durations 0.03-0.27 d)
- **A, real flux:** top-3 peaks 49.723 d (power 1613, SDE 9.3), 38.670 d (1409, SDE 8.0), 41.791 d (1344). Inverted-flux null SDE 7.9. The pipeline period 38.6067 d is *not* the top peak; the nearby 38.670-d peak is 0.063 d away, which is 2.4 d of accumulated phase drift over the baseline, so it is not the same coherent ephemeris. The grid point at 38.607 d has SDE 5.1 and ranks 641st. The BLS power rises steeply with period in A (few deep artefact cadences being connected at long periods), and the inverted spectrum shows the same rise.
- **B, real flux:** top peak 22.881 d with power only 48.7 (SDE 8.0; inverted null 7.3, top inverted peak 2.000 d). 38.6067 d ranks 114,626th of 271,529. No peak in B is distinguishable from the inverted null.

### 3. Characterisation at the pipeline ephemeris (P = 38.6067 d fixed, 0.9-h box, own t0)
Dataset A: t0 = 151.4652 BKJD (BJD 2454984.4652; pipeline 151.4675), box depth **4370 +- 359 ppm** (random-phase empirical error; empirical SNR 12.2; 51 in-box cadences), so the pipeline's 4104 ppm is reproduced. But: odd/even **4.9 sigma** (2898 +- 410 vs 5679 +- 387 ppm); per-year depths **7117 / 3818 / 175 / 5402 ppm**; secondary at phase 0.5 -207 +- 361 ppm (none). Per-event table: 31 of 38 epochs have in-box data; only epochs 0, 10 and 29 (t = 151.47, 537.53, 1271.06) show deficits, and they are single cadences at -39,000 to -55,000 ppm sitting inside the channel-25 segments. Removing those 5 cadences leaves ~0. With P fixed and duration free my BLS prefers 0.60 h (6470 ppm); a local refine within 0.3% moves to 38.670 d with a 4.8-h box, i.e. the "duration" is not defined by a transit shape.
Dataset B: depth 477 +- 122 ppm (SNR 3.9), odd/even 1.1 sigma, per-year 567 / -81 / 523 / 690 ppm, 23 epochs with data. Nothing.

### 4. SAP_FLUX dilution check
A: SAP depth 2012 +- 277 ppm vs PSF 4370 +- 334, ratio 0.46; expected ~1.17 if the dip were on this star (SAP captures 91-95% of the target, which is 80-85% of the aperture flux). An astrophysical dip anywhere in the aperture would give SAP/PSF >= ~1; a ratio of 0.46 is the signature of the PSF model mis-fitting, not of dilution. B: both consistent with zero (477 +- 122 vs 607 +- 142 ppm).

### 5. Comparison with vet.json
Agreements: same t0 to 0.002 d, same box depth (4104 vs 4370 ppm), no secondary (305 ppm / 0.8 sigma vs -207 ppm / -0.6 sigma), similar empirical SNR (10.6 vs 12.2). Disagreements: blind period not recovered; odd/even 0.05 sigma (pipeline) vs 4.9 sigma (mine); the pipeline's own per-quartile depths (106 / 268 / 253 / -114 ppm) and event-weighted depth (177 ppm, event chi2 1.77 for 6 dof) already contradict its headline depth; n_events 7 vs my 31 epochs with data of which 3 carry everything; TLS SDE 7.08 failed the v1.4 rule (stage2_pass_v14 = False) but passed v1.7. No pixel/ directory exists for this target yet.

### Recommendation
Treat kic-005950408 as a channel-25 PSF-fit artefact and drop it from the survivor list. Any pixel-level work would need to exclude Q0/1/5/9/13/17 first, and after that exclusion there is no signal left to localise. More generally, a per-quarter RED_CHI2 (or per-channel scatter) screen before BLS would remove this failure mode for the whole pool; adding it would be a post-hoc rule change and must be logged as such in `prereg_*.json`.
